label: dam-private-probe
_why: PROBE (user, 2026-10-16: "Go with a couple probes with instant tech grants and exaggerated values, just to check. Specifically add Laissez-faire to a couple majors."). Does the dam survey gating still hold if dams may be built PRIVATELY? F239 found laissez-faire hosts building none of their surveyed dams (0 of 6), because dams are government-built only. tools/emit_dams.mjs now takes dams.private: 'all' gives can_build_private the same conditions as can_build_government (construction rights, the builder's own or family survey, the technology, all read on scope:investor_country); 'laissez_faire' the same, only where the host state's owner holds law_laissez_faire. Base book: jex-dam4s-rs-x25-m10ac (F239's book). Probe settings in both arms: the dam technologies to GBR FRA USA PRU AUS RUS at the start, Laissez-faire forced on GBR and USA at the start (FRA, PRU, AUS interventionist and RUS traditionalist stay as they are), 1-month surveys, dam levels at x0.25 cost, +2000 bureaucracy, dam ai_value 300000 (x10).

_arms.dprivall: {kind: config, config: config/mod_config.jex-dam4s-rs-x25-m10ac-dprivall-probe.json} — PROBE ONLY, private dam construction everywhere.
_arms.dprivlf: {kind: config, config: config/mod_config.jex-dam4s-rs-x25-m10ac-dprivlf-probe.json} — PROBE ONLY, private dam construction only in Laissez-faire hosts.

_predictions.private_route: dam levels appear in PRIVATE construction queues (queues.private.by_type building_dam_*) in both arms — at least in GBR and USA, whose governments under Laissez-faire build little; if none appear anywhere, scope:investor_country does not resolve in can_build_private the way it does in the government check, or the private AI does not pick dams
_predictions.survey_gate: every private dam construction is in a state whose site was surveyed by the investor or its family (PMR_DAM survey_complete / family_survey lines) — none in a site nobody in the investor's family surveyed
_predictions.lf_arm: in dprivlf, private dam constructions only in Laissez-faire hosts (GBR, USA states and any country that adopts it); FRA, PRU, AUS and RUS dams only in government queues
_predictions.ownership: read from each run's kept 1842 save: who owns the privately built levels (a financial district, a company, the government, or the building itself)

_stop_rule: none: two probe runs, both play to 1842.
_caveats: Launch ONLY through tools/testbed/launch_detached.ps1 CALLED DIRECTLY from the PowerShell tool (landmine L30).
A level at x0.25 cost builds in roughly 30-55 weeks, so quarterly autosaves are needed to see it in a queue.
